Synopsis:
Ratko Mladić, Bosnian Serb general convicted of genocide for the 1995 Srebrenica massacre, has died in UN custody. The article recounts his war crimes, trial, conviction, and final years of deteriorating health in detention. A UN doctor had assessed his death as imminent weeks prior; his repeated requests for compassionate release were denied.
